summary: Enhance your IT skills with our Performance Measurement and Metrics Training Course. Learn to analyze and improve IT performance effectively. Enroll today!
lede: IT performance measurement helps technology teams connect service data with objectives and management decisions. For professionals who define, analyse, or report IT operations, the course covers mapping objectives to KPIs, validating data sources, and interpreting results against targets. You’ll practise calculating availability, MTTR, and SLA performance, shaping dashboard requirements, and presenting scorecards that support corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technology professionals who define, manage, analyse, or report IT service and operational performance. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical measurement capability without assuming advanced statistics, programming, or enterprise-scale dashboard engineering.
prerequisites: No coding or programming experience is required. Bring examples of existing IT KPIs, service reports, SLA definitions, or dashboard challenges where available. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for exercises. Power BI activities focus on dashboard logic and requirements, so software installation is not mandatory unless your organization already provides access.
